posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
So you basically want to execute two skills at the same time, the one where the weapon damage formula is stored and the additional skill.
That is not exactly easy, not even through common events, because both skills are to a point variable and you can only reference a few things.
Alternatevely you might reference the damage formula in a different place and then add it through notetags, but that would require quite some javascript knowledge.
@Luckysince97
the attack skill trait is new with MZ, it did not exist in MV - that is why the OP needed a plugin for that.

posts.author: Robro33
posts.body:
Ryanmsmb said:
How can i do it then?
Click to expand...
as Andar said, a basic way to set it up would be to have a notetag on your weapons to be their damage formula. something like:
Code:
<WeaponDamage:Math.randomInt(12)+1 + (Math.floor(a.atk/2)-5)>
example being 1d12+ atk mod
and then in the damage formula for your smite you can have it be some formula and add on the formula on the weapon notetag
Code:
Math.randomInt(8) + Math.randomInt(8) + 2 + (a.weapons && a.weapons()[0] && a.weapons()[0].meta.WeaponDamage ? eval(a.weapons()[0].meta.WeaponDamage): 0)
which would be 2d8 + the weapon formula
id personally make a function out of the latter half of that with a plugin for convenience's sake, but its not required
